request.system:
You are an extraction engine for transcripts of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central launch event videos.
You read machine-generated captions that carry a timestamp (seconds) per segment and you return structured JSON.

Hard rules:
- Use only what the transcript says. Do not add product knowledge, context or guesses from outside the transcript.
- Every timestamp you return must be a segment start time "t" that exists in the input, or lie inside a segment's range. Never invent timestamps.
- Quotes must be verbatim substrings of a segment text (same words, same order; you may trim the start and end). 8 to 25 words each. No paraphrasing, no fixing grammar, no stitching segments.
- Status is only what is said or shown in this video: "preview" if they say preview, public preview, beta or similar; "ga" if they say generally available, GA, out of preview, released; "announced" if it is mentioned as coming later, not in this release, roadmap; "unclear" if nothing is said. Always give the quote that proves the status, or null.
- Names of presenters are "as heard"; mark confidence low when the captions could have mangled them.
- No em-dashes anywhere in your text. Use a plain hyphen.
- Write summaries in plain language, no hype words copied from the video (no "exciting", "powerful", "seamless").

output.summary: This video covers a new admin center action in 2026 release wave two that temporarily matches a sandbox database configuration to that of a typical production database. It is meant for developers and administrators who want to check performance or run cloud migration projects under production-like conditions. The video shows the new button, the flyout warning about a restart, and how to track the operation. It then lists the limits: three uses per tenant per calendar month, 72 hours each, an automatic revert, admin center API support, and a paid license requirement.

chapters.title: Overview: matching sandbox to production configuration
Admin center button, flyout and operation tracking
Limits: three times per month, 72 hours each
Automatic revert, admin center API and license requirement

features.name: Match production configuration (sandbox)
features.description: Administrators can temporarily match the configuration of a sandbox database to that of a typical production database. Developers and admins can use it to evaluate how processes would run in production, for example for performance work or cloud migration projects.
caveats: Configuration is temporary and reverts to a typical sandbox configuration

features.name: Restart warning flyout
features.description: The new button in the admin center opens a flyout that explains the action and warns that the environment will restart. Users connected at that moment are disconnected.
caveats: Environment restarts and connected users are disconnected

features.name: Operation tracking in admin center
features.description: Once started, the operation can be tracked like any other admin center operation. The operation details show who started it and when, which also hints at when the environment moves back to a regular sandbox configuration.

features.name: Automatic revert after 72 hours
features.description: The environment reverts to a typical sandbox configuration after 72 hours. The move back happens during the first environment update window after the 72 hours end.
caveats: Revert happens in the first environment update window after the 72 hours end

features.name: Usage limit of three occurrences per month
features.description: The operation is limited to three occurrences per tenant per calendar month, each lasting 72 hours.
caveats: Three occurrences per tenant per calendar month, 72 hours at a time

features.name: Admin center API support
features.description: The match production configuration operation is supported in the admin center APIs, so developers can automate it as part of their development processes.

features.name: Paid license requirement
features.description: The feature is only available on tenants with a paid license type, including partners using the partner sandbox license.
caveats: Not available on tenants without a paid license type
prerequisites: Paid license type or partner sandbox license
